About this item

  • MEET THE GENIUS10 — Similar to our G7200, just better. It's 17% smaller and delivers over 115% more power. It's the all-in-one charging solution - battery charger, battery maintainer, trickle charger, plus desulfator.
  • DO MORE WITH GENIUS — Designed for 6-volt and 12-volt lead-acid (AGM, Gel, SLA, VRLA) and lithium-ion (LiFePO4) batteries, including flooded, maintenance-free, deep-cycle, marine and powersport batteries.
  • ENJOY PRECISION CHARGING — An integrated thermal sensor dynamically adjusts the charge based on ambient temperature, preventing overcharging in hot weather and undercharging in cold, ensuring optimal battery performance.
  • CHARGE DEAD BATTERIES — Charge batteries from as low as 1 volt, or use Force Mode to manually charge completely dead batteries down to zero volts. Perfect for recovering deeply discharged or neglected batteries.
  • BEYOND MAINTENANCE — Keep your battery fully charged without worrying about overcharging. Our smart charger constantly monitors the battery, allowing you to leave it connected safely - indefinitely - for worry-free maintenance.
  • RESTORE YOUR BATTERY — Precision pulse charging automatically detects and reverses battery sulfation and acid stratification, restoring your battery's health for improved performance and extended lifespan.
  • COMPATIBLE — Charges and maintains all types of vehicles, including cars, automobiles, motorcycles, mopeds, lawn mowers, ATVs, UTVs, tractors, trucks, SUVs, RVs, campers, trailers, boats, PWCs, jet skis, classic cars, and more..
  • WHAT'S IN THE BOX — Includes a 10A charger, 72-inch AC cable, 80-inch DC cable with battery clamps, and integrated eyelet terminals, mounting bracket, screws, user manual needs to be read to understand how to properly use the item, and a 3-year warranty. Proudly designed in the USA.

User Guide (PDF)

Product Description

The GENIUS10 is the ultimate all-in-one solution for battery charging, maintenance, and restoration, delivering 17% more power in a 115% smaller design compared to its predecessor, the G7200. Designed for 6-volt and 12-volt lead-acid (AGM, gel, flooded, and deep-cycle) and lithium-ion (LiFePO4) batteries (up to 230 amp-hours), it is compatible with a vast array of vehicles, such as cars, automobiles, motorcycles, dirt bikes, scooters, mopeds, lawn mowers, ATVs, UTVs, tractors, trucks, SUVs, RVs, campers, trailers, boats, PWCs, jet skis, snowmobiles, golf carts, classic cars, and more; including automotive brands like BMW, Mercedes-Benz, Porsche, Bentley, Maserati, Lexus, Audi, Ford, Chevrolet, Corvette, Cadillac, Prius, Toyota, Subaru, Nissan, powersport vehicles such as Harley-Davidson, Honda, Yamaha, Kawasaki, Ducati, Indian, KTM, Husqvarna, Vespa, Polaris, Seadoo, as well as lawn and garden vehicles such as John Deere, Kubota, Toro and more. Featuring an integrated thermal sensor, the GENIUS10 adjusts its charging profile based on ambient temperature, ensuring optimal performance by eliminating the risk of overcharging in hot climates and undercharging in cold ones. It's capable of charging batteries as low as 1 volt and offers a Force Mode for manually charging completely dead batteries (as low as zero volts). With precision pulse charging, the GENIUS10 restores battery health by reversing sulfation and acid stratification, improving performance and extending battery life. Its advanced monitoring system allows for safe, indefinite connection, making it perfect for long-term maintenance. The package includes a 10A charger (120-240VAC), 72-inch AC cable, 80-inch DC cable with battery clamps, and integrated eyelet terminals, mounting bracket and screws, all backed by a three-year warranty. Proudly designed in the USA, the GENIUS10 combines power, reliability, and convenience in a compact design to keep your batteries ready for whatever lies ahead.

    5 out of 5 stars
    Saved bad cell 400ah agm! Proprietary connector.
    Great maintainer and desulphater! Ive been a battery tender guy for decades, but had a set of agm house batteries for an rv that had fallen below their base charge and were showing bad cells when tested. Those batteries wouldnt take a charge from any of my other devices including the battery tender 10A, which is supposed to work on completely dead/sulphated batteries. I figured $100 for the noco genius 10 was a small gamble compared to $2400 for new batteries. I lucked out! Ran each 6v battery up to the full charge it would take 3 times, then hooked the 6v into 12v series, and ran desulphate cycle, then charge cycle then desulphate cycle then charge cycle. Both batteries are now operational again and holding at about 90% capacity consistently. This was achieved over about a 3 week period, but it brought 2 400ah 2.5kw 6v agm batteries back from the dead! Not often am i swayed to change brand loyalty when i find good products, but this frankly crushes all of the competition. The charge current is much more consistent, the cycling pushes enough amperage to actually desulphate but not cook the batteries, and the charge indicator is very accurate. The slow ramp is also excellent and ensures no damage to your batteries by drip feeding the initial amperage. My only complaint is that no manual or instructions were included, so you have no idea what the buttons or lights are actually telling you. Why omit this on a product with such an excellent finish, and great packaging? It took about 20min of google searching to find a comprehensive manual which explains all use options. This could have easily been included in the package instead of the multi page gloss add pamphlet for their other products. One thing to note, is noco uses a proprietary connector, which is rather annoying when all my vehicles have a standard connector hardwired in, but it does seem to create a good and watertight connection . Buy it and save your agm batteries! Lead acid showed decent but not full recovery from full sulphation using the same method, reaching about 78% capacity which is pretty great for lead acid, but not enough to keep you from needing a new battery in most cases.

      Perfect for a second car that doesn't get driven often
      Reviewed in the United States on August 3, 2026
      Size: 10A
      Verified Purchase
      Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
      Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

      I was hesitant to buy one of these because of the reviews about fires. Don't pay attention to those reviews. This little trickle charger keeps your car battery at full and in brand new condition. I read somewhere online that if you put a brand new AGM battery in your car like I did and keep this NOCO Genius10 hooked up, the battery can theoretically last up to 10 years because the NOCO will continuously keep it charged and repaired. It seems that my battery was not the problem with my car as the starter relay on the clutch needed replacing so now my car starts again. But I put in a new AGM battery anyways and won't have to worry about replacing it for another 7-10 years as long as I keep the NOCO attached when not driving the car for long periods of time.

      As for the NOCO functionality itself it has a couple buttons, one to choose what kind of battery you are using, regular 12V, AGM, or Lithium Ion. The other button I believe is for what kind of charge you want(trickle, decharge, repair) but since I have a brand new battery I simply keep it on trickle charge.

      The cord length is not very long so in order for my NOCO to reach my car battery and the wall socket in my garage I used a decent gauge extension cord. The instructions say not to use an extension cord but there is no other way since my wall outlet in my garage is too far away from the car battery. I keep a smoke detector next to the NOCO and battery just to be safe. I got the NOCO on sale during Prime Day so it is definitely a good value for the money. So far so good.

      Purchased the NOCO Genius charger in hopes it would resurrect my battery. Un fortunately, it did not save my battery, but I cannot blame that on the charger.

      The only complaint I have is the lack of instructions. They were not minimal, there were none at all provided with the unit. Luckily, able to look on line and find plenty of videos, however, this does not negate the need for an instruction and care pamphlet.

      The unit feels solidly built and works as expected. While it did not resurrect my battery as it claims it can do (not in all situations), mine was 5 years old, lead acid and probably just to far gone for help. However, it is doing a great job charging my marine battery and using it to keep it charged until used again.

      I like it. Much more compact than the older styles and easily able to mount to a wall or post as a charging station. I would definitely buy again.

      Pretty neat device, very capable as well
      Reviewed in the United States on July 29, 2026
      Size: 10A
      Verified Purchase
      Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
      Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

      I have a battery charger made in the 1970s, inherited from dad that passed away in 2011. It was time for another one, and I was going to buy another Schumacher that weights about 15 Lbs. Was ready to pull the trigger and decided to see if something better was out there, thus buying a Genius 10 instead based on YouTube reviews.

      The Genius 10 was much larger and heavier than how it looks in the picture. The build quality is really good in my eyes, looks like tough ABS polymer, very nice cords with that good feeling wire jacket insulation. The new clamps are nice looking and very practical to me. It's heavy and awkward to store, so I bought the Noco case as well; I thought the other case was too small in size.

      I ran some test with it, on a 12V Honda Lead Acid and Group H8 AGM battery and was happy the results. It was more intuitive than the 1970s version I have with 30 amp boost that is scary to use. What I like with Noco or Genius, it's several tools in one unit, so every 3 or 4 months, I can use the Genius to check the status of all my batteries, well that is the plan at least. One neat thing, using the 12V output to keep a battery online while changing a battery, so the cars computer keeps running and doesn't reboot from removing the battery causing weird things to happen.

      I have no regrets in my purchase and bought the case to enhance it more. I think the price is reasonable as well considering what a $100 buys today.

      Saved me from buying a new battery!
      Reviewed in the United States on January 4, 2024
      Size: 10A
      Verified Purchase
      Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
      Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

      EDIT 2/26/24: I am now the blocks "AAA". Been helping people start their cars when jump starts with cables have not worked. Definitely handy to get other people out of an otherwise expensive pinch.

      I have a car battery that I purchased around 2016 (date of review 1/3/24). The car itself does not get driven much, at most 2-3 times a week no longer than 15 minutes one way.

      Throughout the years I've drained it by leaving the car lights on. Its always required a jump start after that to get going again. Recently I've been an idiot and been leaving my lights on more frequently. Eventually it required me to jump start everytime I wanted to turn on the car. It was becoming a hassle and I was about to call it quits and purchase a new battery until I came across Project Farm's review on battery chargers. This was at the top of the list so I figured to give it a shot.

      I was not disappointed! I charged it for 4 days straight, put it in my car, and it started right up. Not surprised considering it was just charged but the real test laid ahead. I was going to be out of town for two weeks and leave the car sitting. I came back two weeks later and the car started up, no hesitation whatsoever, as if it was a different battery!

      The NOCO Genius 10 saved me about $150-200 at least in a brand new battery. On top of that, I can now use it for other batteries in the event of any similar issues. The instructions on the other hand are a bit confusing and had to rely on YouTube comments to piece it together.

      For those who are confused at what to do, I did not do a 12V repair (function which this unit has) as it requires the battery to be completely charged first. All I did was charge it straight for 4 days uninterrupted.

      When first put on battery to the charger it will be in standby mode. You push (or hold depending on what you need) the MODE button to select your desired option. I was charging a lead acid battery so I selected 12V. The meter at the top slowly advanceD from each of the four bars until the final bar was pulsing green which indicates its charging to full (over 80% I believe). The green charging light continued to slowly pulse even on the 4th day but I took a gamble and disconnected it from the battery. For the battery to be 100% charged, the green light should stay solid. That means my battery worked 2 weeks later after sitting and it wasn't even at 100%.

      The unit can also force a charge on batteries that are extremely under voltage. Thats a separate setting that I haven't had to use yet. It can also charge AGM and Lithium but I believe the 12V repair function is only for lead acid.

      Unfortunately I had to go through 3 separate orders because the first two were from Amazon Warehouse and I encountered issues with both, consecutively. I ended up getting frustrated and just purchased a brand new charger.

      Pros:

      Solid build quality

      Excellent cable connections with weather covers

      Compatible with a wide variety of batteries

      Repair and Force charge batteries

      Cons:

      Poor instructions

      Charge is slow BUT I think thats how these chargers work

      TL;DR

      Try this first before rushing to get a new battery it is a good investment that can save you a lot of money

Chance are that I gave the kid at Advanced Auto parts a free ATV/motorcycle battery because if he had one of these NOCO 10s, chances are he saved the battery and got new life into it. Cant go wrong with this especially for the fast charging, force recharge mode, and versatility to charge, maintain, and breathe batteries back to life. Just one more thing, First time charging the battery after sitting idle for 3 weeks and 2 uses in my case and charged it to full literally in 5 min. I like the unit for keeping the battery at full between uses and not overcharging costing me $300 for a new battery. Well worth the money for less worry and hassle.       5 out of 5 stars
      Funcionó muy bien en mi acumulador AGM (770CCA y 70AH)
      Reviewed in Mexico on August 26, 2022
      Size: 10A
      Verified Purchase
      Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
      Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

      El cargador llego en un día, el precio en Amazon esta elevado comparado con otros sitios sin embargo la recepción en un día me favoreció. Me lo recomendó un amigo que se dedica a la mecánica automotriz, mi camioneta apenas encendía, especialmente los lunes después de no usarla sábados y domingos, las primeras dos fotografías muestran el estado del acumulador (LTH AGM 48, 760CCA y 70AH) antes de usar el NOCO Genius10, básicamente parecía que el acumulador estaba bien cargado sin embargo se bajaba rápido y le faltaba potencia de arranque, después de conectarlo al Genius10 y dejar que realizara una carga completa (aproximadamente unas 4 horas y hasta que el led verde dejo de parpadear), para después correr el reparador por aproximadamente 4 horas más la batería quedo completamente restaurada, como se puede ver en las dos siguientes fotografías. Ya instalado de regreso en mi camioneta el arranque es inmediato y sin esfuerzo. La batería ya se había cargado antes con otros cargadores diferentes, pero no funcionaba bien casi de inmediato daba problemas en el arranque de nuevo y el SOH (state of health) seguía en los 80,s ahora es del 100%, así mismo el estado de carga (SOC) nunca llegaba al 100%... este cargado rehabilito mi acumulador con alrededor de dos años de uso, y que por descuidos míos se había dejado descargar al dejar accesorios prendidos en la camioneta en varias ocasiones. Lo recomiendo ampliamente.

    Product Summary: NOCO GENIUS10 10A 6/12V Smart Battery Charger, Trickle Charger & Maintainer | Overcharge Protection, Desulfator, Temperature Compensation, Force Mode, For Lead-Acid (Wet, Gel, AGM) & Lithium (LiFePO4)

    About this Item

    • MEET THE GENIUS10 — Similar to our G7200, just better. It's 17% smaller and delivers over 115% more power. It's the all-in-one charging solution - battery charger, battery maintainer, trickle charger, plus desulfator.
    • DO MORE WITH GENIUS — Designed for 6-volt and 12-volt lead-acid (AGM, Gel, SLA, VRLA) and lithium-ion (LiFePO4) batteries, including flooded, maintenance-free, deep-cycle, marine and powersport batteries.
    • ENJOY PRECISION CHARGING — An integrated thermal sensor dynamically adjusts the charge based on ambient temperature, preventing overcharging in hot weather and undercharging in cold, ensuring optimal battery performance.
    • CHARGE DEAD BATTERIES — Charge batteries from as low as 1 volt, or use Force Mode to manually charge completely dead batteries down to zero volts. Perfect for recovering deeply discharged or neglected batteries.
    • BEYOND MAINTENANCE — Keep your battery fully charged without worrying about overcharging. Our smart charger constantly monitors the battery, allowing you to leave it connected safely - indefinitely - for worry-free maintenance.
    • RESTORE YOUR BATTERY — Precision pulse charging automatically detects and reverses battery sulfation and acid stratification, restoring your battery's health for improved performance and extended lifespan.
    • COMPATIBLE — Charges and maintains all types of vehicles, including cars, automobiles, motorcycles, mopeds, lawn mowers, ATVs, UTVs, tractors, trucks, SUVs, RVs, campers, trailers, boats, PWCs, jet skis, classic cars, and more..
    • WHAT'S IN THE BOX — Includes a 10A charger, 72-inch AC cable, 80-inch DC cable with battery clamps, and integrated eyelet terminals, mounting bracket, screws, user manual needs to be read to understand how to properly use the item, and a 3-year warranty. Proudly designed in the USA.

    Product Description

    The GENIUS10 is the ultimate all-in-one solution for battery charging, maintenance, and restoration, delivering 17% more power in a 115% smaller design compared to its predecessor, the G7200. Designed for 6-volt and 12-volt lead-acid (AGM, gel, flooded, and deep-cycle) and lithium-ion (LiFePO4) batteries (up to 230 amp-hours), it is compatible with a vast array of vehicles, such as cars, automobiles, motorcycles, dirt bikes, scooters, mopeds, lawn mowers, ATVs, UTVs, tractors, trucks, SUVs, RVs, campers, trailers, boats, PWCs, jet skis, snowmobiles, golf carts, classic cars, and more; including automotive brands like BMW, Mercedes-Benz, Porsche, Bentley, Maserati, Lexus, Audi, Ford, Chevrolet, Corvette, Cadillac, Prius, Toyota, Subaru, Nissan, powersport vehicles such as Harley-Davidson, Honda, Yamaha, Kawasaki, Ducati, Indian, KTM, Husqvarna, Vespa, Polaris, Seadoo, as well as lawn and garden vehicles such as John Deere, Kubota, Toro and more. Featuring an integrated thermal sensor, the GENIUS10 adjusts its charging profile based on ambient temperature, ensuring optimal performance by eliminating the risk of overcharging in hot climates and undercharging in cold ones. It's capable of charging batteries as low as 1 volt and offers a Force Mode for manually charging completely dead batteries (as low as zero volts). With precision pulse charging, the GENIUS10 restores battery health by reversing sulfation and acid stratification, improving performance and extending battery life. Its advanced monitoring system allows for safe, indefinite connection, making it perfect for long-term maintenance. The package includes a 10A charger (120-240VAC), 72-inch AC cable, 80-inch DC cable with battery clamps, and integrated eyelet terminals, mounting bracket and screws, all backed by a three-year warranty. Proudly designed in the USA, the GENIUS10 combines power, reliability, and convenience in a compact design to keep your batteries ready for whatever lies ahead.
